name: Teldrassil
summary: After the harpies are driven back, Arynia Cloudsbreak sends you with a report to Darnassus. The inscribed bark tells Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm about the boughs and the corruption still troubling the World Tree.

sections.title: A Messenger to the Stone City
sections.body: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak entrusts you with a piece of inscribed bark after you clear the harpies from their nests in the Oracle Glade. The Oracle Tree watches over the forest, and with the harpies gone, Arynia can send word to the kaldorei leadership. You carry her report through the wilderness to Darnassus, the great forest of stone, and deliver it to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm.

sections.title: Staghelm's Ambition and Frustration
sections.body: Fandral Staghelm receives the report with mixed feelings. He is grateful to hear that the harpies have been pushed back, but the report shows how one threat gives way to another across Teldrassil. Staghelm championed the planting of the new World Tree to reclaim the night elves' lost immortality. The afflictions in its boughs remind him that his work remains far from finished.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest 'Teldrassil'?
faq.answer: You carry Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak's report from the Oracle Tree to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus. The inscribed bark bears news of the tree after you drive back the harpies.

Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf Sentinel stationed near the Oracle Tree in Teldrassil's wilds. She watches regional threats, including the Bloodfeather harpies, and coordinates forest defenses with Darnassus.

faq.q: Why does Arynia call Darnassus a 'forest of stone'?
faq.answer: Darnassus is called a forest of stone because its temples, bridges, and pavilions are built of marble and stone. The night elves live within the World Tree's canopy, while the city rises among these structures.

faq.q: Why is Fandral Staghelm so concerned about the Oracle Tree's report?
faq.answer: Fandral Staghelm is concerned because the report describes corruption and turmoil among the wildlife on Teldrassil. He championed the tree's planting in hopes of restoring kaldorei immortality after Nordrassil was damaged in the Third War, and these afflictions threaten that ambition.

faq.q: What quest leads into this, and what follows it?
faq.answer: You arrive after dealing with the harpies threatening the Oracle Tree in The Enchanted Glade. After you deliver the report to Arch Druid Staghelm, he sends you to Darkshore with Grove of the Ancients.

faq.q: Where can Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm be found?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm resides in Darnassus, at the summit of the Cenarion Enclave. There he oversees the druids of the Cenarion Circle and guides kaldorei governance.

angles.text: As a night elf, you bring the report to Arch Druid Staghelm and learn of his drive to restore kaldorei immortality through Teldrassil's troubled boughs.
As a druid, you carry word from the Oracle Tree to the leader of the Cenarion Circle, where the struggle to cleanse Teldrassil's natural balance is plain.
As an Alliance champion, you receive a formal introduction to the night elf capital and its stern leadership.
